text:
maria: Heads up — AcmeDigital VIP rollout tomorrow 09:00 PST. Expect an initial spike (~2k rps) for embedding calls; potential queue buildup. Need oncall coverage and a short checklist.

aj: I end my shift at 08:30 PST but can extend to cover the 09:00 ramp until ~10:00. Add my pager to the watchlist.

leo: @maria noted. Canary plan: 10% traffic at 09:00, 50% at 09:15, 100% at 09:30 if metrics look stable. Primary things to watch: model p99 latency, batch-queue-length, KV cache hit rate.

dion: Tagging infra — expect GPU util spikes during warmup. If p99 > 750ms for >5m, recommended action is rollback or reroute to quantized variant.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: acme/vip-rollout v2.3 -> canary 09:00 PST. Status: pending.

maria: Quick oncall notes to leave: contact list, rollback command, dashboards, and pre-rollout load check timing.

leo: Contacts: @maria (PM), @aj (oncall), @dion (infra). Pager: +1-555-0102. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/inference/acme/dashboards

aj: Rollback snippet (CLI):
```
# rollback to stable
redwood deploy rollback --service acme-vip --to stable
```

dion: FYI the earlier internal load run hit ~1.8k rps with a 12% tail increase. Devs pushed a batching tweak this morning; we'll do a short pre-rollout load check 30m before canary.

maria: Action items:
- aj: pre-rollout sanity test at 08:30 PST and post results here
- leo: enable temporary alerts for model_p99 and batch_queue_length threshold breaches
- dion: standby for immediate reroute or kernel-level rollback

aj: Got it — will run sanity and report back. :thumbsup:

leo: Note for contracts: AcmeDigital SLA is 99.9% with 500ms objective. If we hit sustained degradation, ensure notes for postmortem and customer comms.

maria: Thanks — leaving these notes for the next oncall and the watch team. If anyone needs to swap coverage please ping here so we can arrange.

aj: Pre-rollout sanity done at 08:32 PST — batch hit 92%, p99 380ms, no errors. I'm oncall through 10:00 and will post live updates during canary. :eyes:
